add.title: Nthabiseng Mokoena v Head of Johannesburg Correctional Centre and Others, Case No. 2024/070075 - High Court of South Africa, Gauteng Local Division, Johannesburg (Fisher J), judgment of 10 November 2025
add.summary: National placement standard governing trans prisoners in every province including Eastern Cape: the judgment records that DCS agrees that, under the regulations to the Correctional Services Act relating to accommodation of vulnerable inmates and the DCS Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), inmates should be accommodated in cells appropriate to their gender identity where feasible and safe; DCS further conceded its own SOPs prescribe single-cell accommodation for transgender inmates. The Equality Court, applying these instruments, ordered the DCS to accommodate the complainant in a single cell or in the same cell with inmates of the same gender identity. This is the operative rule for where trans prisoners are housed in Eastern Cape correctional centres (e.g., St Albans, Mthatha, East London), no province-specific trans-placement case being on record.
